sources.entry: Task Keeper - List editor for power users, backed by a self-hosted server. Apache-2.0 Scala

summary.one_liner: Piga is a self-hosted list editor for power users, built around keyboard shortcuts for editing nested task lists and notes across multiple documents.
summary.what_it_does: Piga is a web-based list editor aimed at power users, with example uses such as TODO lists, meal and ingredient lists, meeting notes, and reminders. It offers many keyboard shortcuts for indentation, text formatting, undo/redo, task swapping, duplicating, deleting, and collapsing or expanding indented tasks. Tasks can carry tags and links, and text can be converted between uppercase, lowercase, CamelCase, snake_case, and dash-case. Copy, cut, and Markdown-copy of a task with its children are supported. Users can keep many documents and switch between them quickly. The README describes a server with user accounts, backed by a database (MariaDB/MySQL in the examples), and includes an optional delayed-task queue that relies on specially tagged tasks and a daily external API call.
use_cases: Keep a TODO list with keyboard-driven editing
Maintain a meal plan and ingredient list
Keep a personal list of things to remember
Manage nested, collapsible task outlines across several documents
how_to_run: Download 'Binaries (compiled files) with demo configuration' from the latest release and unpack the archive
Edit conf/application.conf to configure a database (e.g. MariaDB) and set play.http.secret.key and app.setup.defaultPassword
Run bin/server -DdropAndCreateNewDb to create database tables, then bin/server -DcreateAdminUser to create the admin user
Run bin/server and browse to port 9000 at /app/useradministration (admin / changeme)
Alternatively, use the Docker instructions: set APPLICATION_SECRET, run docker-compose run web bin/server with -DdropAndCreateNewDb and -DcreateAdminUser, then docker-compose up
notable: Extensive keyboard shortcuts for outline editing, formatting, and case conversion
Collapse and expand of indented tasks beneath a selected task
Tag support for tasks, including special tags for a delayed-task queue
Docker Compose option alongside a plain binary install
caveats: Requires a database setup (MariaDB/MySQL example given) and Java 11 on the server
The delayed-task feature needs a daily external API call and specific tags
Setup is manual: default admin password must be changed, and secrets must be chosen
